thread:
Lena (CS): AcornBio sent a 120-question vendor security form and said it's blocking renewal next month. can we triage and get a concise response pack? link: https://acornbio.example.com/form/12
Sam (Security): I'll run the SOC2/controls bundle and draft KMS answers. quick Q: do we have a canonical embeddings retention number to put in the form?
Jamal (Infra): Hosted embeddings retention = 90 days by default. Dedicated/Private = customer-configurable. Hosted uses cloud-managed keys (no BYOK). Dedicated supports BYOK via KMS. Private is customer-managed. Backups for Hosted are cross-region snapshots.
Ana (Docs): i'll write a short, plain-language blurb for the vendor team: what BYOK means, what we can and cannot promise, and the data deletion lifecycle.
Maria (CSM): customer is on Growth plan; they asked about Dedicated last quarter. offering a 30-day Dedicated trial + pricing uplift could reduce churn risk. do we want to include that in the cover note?
Lena (CS): yes — include an optional trial + clear pricing delta and SLOs. also we need to standardize "data deletion on termination" text to match our DPA.
Sam (Security): assembling evidence bundle now. evidence-bot: uploaded evidence bundle v3 by Sam to /customer_evidence/acornbio/evidence-v3.zip :white_check_mark:
Sam (Security): also adding screenshots of KMS console and a matrix showing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for keys, logs, retention. ETA 3pm PT today.
Jamal (Infra): note for the matrix: Hosted audit logs have tenant identifiers in application logs but not in low-level cloud provider audit blobs; Dedicated can surface tenant IDs if configured. Backups: Hosted snapshots retained for 90 days in primary+secondary region; deletion from cold backups may lag — call this "archival window" in vendor language.
Tess (Legal): don't commit to absolute instant deletion for cross-region backups. we'll sign off on wording that says backups are purged within 30 days of termination except for archival/restore windows which may be longer; legal to review final draft.
Ana (Docs): draft snippet for the form field: `embeddingsRetentionDays: 90` and "For Dedicated and Private deployments, customers can configure retention via the console or APIs." I'll add a short FAQ line about BYOK availability.
Maria (CSM): i'll prepare a 1-page cover note for AcornBio's vendor team summarizing: 1) SOC2 report (available on NDA) 2) BYOK availability (Dedicated/Private only) 3) Data deletion & backup archival language 4) Proposed 30-day Dedicated trial + cost delta.
Lena (CS): perfect. once Sam drops the answers & evidence into /customer_evidence/acornbio/ i'll send the packet and schedule a call. ping legal for fast review.
Sam (Security): final answers uploaded to /customer_evidence/acornbio/final-answers.pdf and evidence zip. pinged @Lena and @Tess. :rocket:
Lena (CS): got it. i'll send to AcornBio and propose a Friday call to walk their vendor team through the answers. thanks everyone — moving fast should reduce the renewal risk.
